rules.install:
cd $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR
if [ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" != "/tools" ]; then make OSBITS="`bh_os_bits $AELTRA_HOST_TYPE`" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install else install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/bin" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/include" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/lib" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/libexec" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/sbin" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/share"
for entry in etc var run tmp; do ln -sf "../$entry" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/$entry" done
ln -sf . "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/usr" ln -sf . "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/tools"
# just assume it's always x86_64 ln -sf lib "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/tools/lib64" fi
